paper.title: EcoAgent: An Efficient Device-Cloud Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Mobile Automation
paper.central_claim: EcoAgent is a privacy-aware efficient closed-loop device–cloud mobile multi-agent framework: cloud Dual-ReACT plans with expectations, local execution/observation verifies and summarizes screens, failure feedback triggers replanning, matching fully cloud-based task success while reducing resource use and latency.

evidence.support_explanation: Planner emits per-step action and expected outcome; actionable interface, not merely role names.
Small VLM checks screenshot vs expectation; no formal state oracle at runtime.
Author claims screenshot compression, not information-theoretic privacy.
27.6 vs M3A28.4, below AgentS2 54.3 and V-Droid59.5; cannot claim all cloud agents matched.
OS-Atlas executor4.3, planner19.0, full27.6; adding observer bundles verification, summaries and reflection.
Cloud-call/token economy vs M3A13.39/87469, not total FLOPs or total money.

evidence.quote: All device-side models are deployed on a local server with an NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU (24G) to simulate mobile inference.
evidence.support_explanation: Actual phone power/thermal/latency not tested; device claims simulated.
20 sampled failures: planning7,grounding10,maxsteps2,verification1; not classwise observer accuracy.
Seconds per execution step on simulated device setup, not real-phone end-to-end latency.
Smaller uplink, not privacy leakage/security audit.

evidence.quote: After executing an action, M3A reflects on its effect by observing any state changes
evidence.support_explanation: Actual M3A ancestor already has feedback; contribution relocates/compresses verification, not inventing feedback in agents.

evidence.quote: Determining reward signals from system state has several benefits.
evidence.support_explanation: Independent programmatic outcome basis stronger than screenshot observer self-declaration.

signatures.object: Mobile task decomposed between cloud GPT-4o planner and local specialized grounder/general2B observer
signatures.information: Initial screenshot exposed to cloud; subsequent raw screens local; compact textual summaries and failure feedback cloud-visible.
signatures.operation: Global/local ReACT emits JSON steps+expectations; grounder executes; observer checks poststate; failure triggers memory-conditioned cloud replan.
signatures.conditions: Expected postcondition screen-visible; small observer reliable; errors recoverable; summaries retain discriminative facts.
signatures.feedback: Local VLM yes/no expectation check; external AndroidWorld checker for reported final success.
signatures.selection_rule: Continue plan on successful local verification, replan on failure; no task-crossing learned selection.
signatures.selection_data: Current-task screen/action history; no offline training performed for this framework.
signatures.persistence: Within-task memory trajectory and revised plan; no demonstrated cross-task retained self-improvement.
signatures.later_use: Subsequent steps in same task only.
signatures.claimed_effect: 27.6%SR with1.53cloud calls/3240cloud tokens;3.9sstep using ShowUI setup.
signatures.failure_boundary: False-positive observer, lossy textual content, irreversible actions and RTX3090 surrogate for mobile inference.

gap.author_gap: Cloud agents incur repeated screenshot/token cost and privacy exposure; open-loop device-cloud grounding lacks efficient local feedback.
gap.checked_gap: Cloud/local capability split and communication cost are concrete; M3A already closes action/reflection loop, so defensible residual is local verification/compressed feedback rather than feedback itself.

lineage.relationship: M3A ReAct+reflection ancestor; AndroidWorld external outcome checker

gap.residue: Push routine expectation checks and screen summarization to small local models while retaining cloud replan.
gap.stakes: Cloud communication economy is valuable; privacy and real-device speed need separate proof.
gap.method_response: Typed step/expectation handoff, local observer+text compression, failure escalation.
gap.remaining_gap: No privacy leakage test, observer accuracy audit, physical-device deployment or separate compression/Dual-ReACT controls.

reason: Complete calibrated-draft initial review; online and scoped. No independent reproduction.
rationale: A coherent location/capability decomposition with meaningful cloud-communication measurements and role-addition evidence. The strongest claim is near-M3A point estimates, not cloud-agent equivalence generally. RTX3090 simulation prevents treating latency as real-phone performance, and text compression is not a privacy guarantee. Missing observer reliability, precise matched budgets and repeats limit causal and deployment confidence.
